title: Events infrastructure upgrade
summary: Major improvements and preparations for the TheySix Events server.
description: Updated and restored several systems behind TheySix Events while preparing the server for upcoming events and improving overall compatibility.

body.text: Updated the TheySix Events setup, including game messages, menus, rewards and other event-related configurations. All 19 event games successfully loaded during testing.
Restored the NPC and hologram systems used for interactive displays and leaderboards throughout the Events server.
Improved the event lobby setup and prepared /spawn to bring players directly to the event lobby.
Improved compatibility for both Java and Bedrock players, including updates to cross-version support and preservation of Bedrock-specific server features.
Restored the server's moderation backend and successfully verified that it loads with the updated Events server configuration.
Removed several outdated and unused server components and restored dependencies required by the current server setup.
Completed a successful test startup with 45 plugins initialized. TheySix Events reached its ready state and the server completed startup normally.
